art_style: Single-weight technical linework with square junctions and open negative space.

abstract mark.reason: A branch pattern reads at navigation size and reflects source work.

wordmark.reason: Compact text reads well in the directory and can stand alone.

emblem.reason: An enclosed mark is orderly and can work as a repository avatar.

mascot.reason: A character would compete with the maintainer's task list.

concepts.example: A three-node branch with a square main junction and open endpoints, placed left of Branchwell.
concepts.rationale: Recognizable at 16px and related directly to repo work. The distinctive junction needs a reduction test.

concepts.example: Branchwell set as a compact standalone wordmark with a cut on the leading B stem.
concepts.rationale: Legible in dense headers, with less recognition when only an icon fits.

concepts.example: A small stepped directory tab enclosing a single branch node and leading stem.
concepts.rationale: Strong favicon silhouette with less room to show the branch at its smallest size.

selection_reason: Highest weighted score. It pairs the clearest repo association with a viable one-color navigation scale.

confirmation.reference: Owner confirmed Keep Branchwell for both exact names on 2026-11-19.
